# Dandy Stays

> Dandy Stays (Pine & Dandy LLC) is the home of two vacation rental brands run by hosts Ethan & Molly.

- [Pine & Dandy](https://www.thepineanddandy.com/): two lakefront log cabins in Eagle River, Wisconsin. The O.G. on Lake Arbutus (sleeps 8) and The Grandy Dandy on the Sugar Camp Chain (sleeps 10).
- Sandy Dandy (https://www.staysandydandy.com/): a Florida beach condo, opening soon.
- [Returning-guest text deals](https://www.thepineanddandy.com/texts.html)
